response.text:
I can’t reliably give you the “latest” FDA guidance and an authoritative effective date purely from memory — those facts change and you specifically need a citable source for a compliance memo. I must look it up to be sure and to give you the correct title, effective date, and a link you can cite.

May I search the FDA website now and return:
- the exact guidance title,
- the effective (or release) date,
- a short one-paragraph summary you can drop into your memo,
- and a formatted citation (you can choose APA/Chicago/MLA)?

If yes, tell me which citation style you prefer and I’ll fetch and cite the official source.
